description: This Java source file implements the 'Packaging' interface with a class named 'DefaultPackagingImpl'. It provides methods to calculate shipping package details based on product dimensions, weight, and merchant store configuration. The code handles packaging logic, box fitting, and volume/weight constraints, and uses Spring's dependency injection for services.
